name: Walkthrough recorder
responsibility: Runs a recording's two passes: proves ffmpeg first, records the talk in a live page, keeps it, then has it drawn frame by frame
description: Pass 1's browser is started with audio allowed to play and a fake microphone playing a second of silence, because voice will not start without a microphone and would hear Chromium's default tone as somebody speaking. It captures nothing and needs no GPU: nobody looks at the page, whose reports are what the server hands the voice. A board drawn at another version while it was recorded fails the recording and nothing is kept, since no one picture goes with that talk. The talk is written before pass 2 starts, so a render that fails keeps it. Both passes find ffmpeg and start their browser through the same two helpers (lib/tools.ts). An interrupt stops the browser at once, so every call waiting on it fails and nothing is written. The recording page names the repository of the command's vault as repoA, so it reads that vault.
